Technology stocks were falling in recent trading, with the shares of tech companies in the S&P 500 losing almost 1.8% in value, while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was dropping nearly 2.2%.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) CommScope ( COMM ) rose almost 7% on Monday after the wireless network equipment company reported preliminary Q4 revenue in a range of $1.05 billion to $1.07 billion, exceeding the Street view of $1.04 billion.
In other sector news:
(+) Versum Matierals ( VSM ) jumped out to a 15.5% gain on Monday after agreeing to a $3.83 billion merger offer from rival semiconductor supplier Entegris ( ENTG ). Under terms of the proposed all-stock transaction, investors will receive 1.12 Entegris shares for each Versum share they now own, valuing the target company at about $35.08 per share, equal to a 10.8% premium based on Friday's closing price for the two stocks.
(-) NVIDIA Corp ( NVDA ) slumped 15% on Monday after the chipmaker cut its Q4 revenue forecast to a range of $2.16 billion to $2.24 billion, down $500 million from the mid-point of its prior range and lagging the $2.70 billion analyst mean.
